found_by: the pre-release audit; kept here as the bootstrap proof of the red-first-patch mechanism
base: ext4dump format 4 on a 4 MiB file, one file /victim with 11 bytes

edits.what: inode 12's root extent header, inside i_block[] at offset 40

symptom: eh_max is the stride to the checksum tail (12 + 12 * eh_max, which for 0xFFFF lands 786 KB past a 4 KiB block) and eh_entries bounds the binary search every lookup runs. Reading /victim was a heap-buffer-overflow in ext4_ext_binsearch.
